safe_harbor: Educational information only. Not financial advice. Prices can move materially around earnings.

quote_source.name: Stock Analysis historical regular-session closes; issuer releases and SEC filings for fundamentals
quote_source.note: All recorded prices are October 14, 2026 closes in USD. October 15 live prices and provider valuation ratios are not mixed into the closing-price snapshot. Rankings are research selections, not executed trades.

market_emotion.basis: SOXX fell 4.50% on October 14. CRDO, MRVL and PDFS fell substantially more than the sector. ASML's current demand outlook and Micron's earnings remain strong, but higher discount rates, AI project funding and future memory supply challenge valuations.
market_emotion.interpretation: Qualitative risk heat, not a second stock score or calibrated sentiment probability.

strict_scoring.score_formula: forward fundamental surprise + narrative and expectation shift + supply-chain moat and diffusion + valuation and reaction gap + financial quality and positioning risk + evidence integrity
strict_scoring.interpretation: The score is an ordinal research rank, not a calibrated probability, target return, or backtested alpha estimate.
hard_gates: Current attributable earnings release and filing review
No unresolved accounting or liquidity red flag
Price and valuation considered relative to expectations
A score of at least 82 is necessary but execution also requires the stated condition
No automatic market order; the eligible list can be empty when price or evidence gates fail

position_sizing_overlay.rule: Use the conviction rank only for selection. Size is reduced independently for volatility, portfolio correlation, crowding, customer concentration, liquidity, and earnings risk.
position_sizing_overlay.initial_size: No more than about one-quarter of intended exposure for current staged buys, and only when each stated price condition is met.
position_sizing_overlay.exit_rule: Review or exit when the guidance, demand, margin, cash-flow, customer, or supply-chain thesis breaks; do not rely on price stops alone.

MU.reason: Largest verified quarterly profit growth in this reviewed sample. FY26 Q4 net income $37.701B versus $3.201B; FY27 Q1 revenue guide $61.5B. Low earnings multiples may reflect peak-cycle margins and rising competition, so use a cycle-capped starter.

AVGO.reason: Q3 AI revenue grew 221%, free cash flow reached $13.665B, and the newer 10-Q shows $179.2B remaining performance obligations and $59.419B carrying debt. Custom compute and networking diversify the demand source, while funding and site timing remain key risks.

ASML.reason: Fresh October 14 results: EUR11.662B revenue, EUR4.960B net income, 57.5% gross margin and a EUR14.2B-EUR15.2B Q4 sales guide. Management says planned 2027-2028 supply will not fully meet demand. Valuation and customer capex concentration cap the score.

NVDA.reason: FY27 Q2 net income grew 125.9% and revenue reached $96.221B. Full-rack systems and software retain the strongest compute position, but investment gains, large commitments, customer financing and competing inference architectures require deductions.

KLAC.reason: Process-control intensity remains attractive, but the evidence is older than ASML's new quarter and the current tape does not justify a fresh entry.

CRDO.reason: OCP broadens the platform into 1.6T light cables and inference memory connectivity. These remain future commercialization opportunities; Q1 customer concentration, $87.979M stock compensation and weak cash conversion still cap per-share confidence.

MRVL.reason: October 6 management outlook raised FY28 revenue to about $20B. This improves the forward signal, but the 10-Q's customer warrant, acquisition accounting, program concentration and sharp price reversal still constrain the score.

FORM.reason: Q2 GAAP profit grew about 518%, confirming HBM and optical test demand. At $119.71, even a ten-year 10x requires far more profit than the current run rate, so it remains a speculative research candidate.

PDFS.reason: Q2 GAAP net income rose to $4.271M from $1.146M, but platform revenue declined sequentially and diluted shares increased. The ten-year 10x earnings hurdle is exceptionally demanding.

rankings.positioning: Four research candidates clear 82. Initial exposure, when conditions are satisfied, is at most one-quarter of intended size. October 14 closes are reference prices, not limits or fills. Do not average down after a guide, margin, funding or customer thesis break.
keep_caution_today: CRDO: commercial proof, concentration, cash conversion and valuation
MRVL: dilution-adjusted growth and program execution
FORM and PDFS: ambitious ten-year earnings hurdles and upcoming quarterly checks

execution_conditions.MU: Wait for selling pressure to settle and a regular-session close back above $950 before a starter; reassess if demand or pricing weakens.
execution_conditions.AVGO: Prefer an orderly retest and hold of the $340-$350 zone; defer while price is making new lows or the funding thesis worsens.
execution_conditions.ASML: Require the earnings-reset area near $1,650 to hold or be reclaimed; use a limit order and verify EUR earnings versus USD ADR pricing.
execution_conditions.NVDA: Prefer stabilization around $220-$225; defer below $220 until support is reclaimed. Do not treat a falling quote as automatic value.

supply_chain_view.framework: Cash-funded capacity -> manufacturable chips -> reliable networks -> powered and cooled sites -> useful tokens
supply_chain_view.forecast_horizon: October 2026 to October 2028; analyst assessment, not a certainty
next_two_year_bottlenecks: Lithography output: ASML says planned 2027 and 2028 supply will not fully meet customer demand
HBM4 qualification, DRAM process yield and multi-tier inference memory capacity
Advanced packaging, substrates and known-good-die / optical-engine testing
1.6T links, 224G signaling, lasers, fiber assembly, link telemetry and network reliability
Grid connections, transformers, 800VDC conversion, liquid-cooling qualification and powered sites
Project financing and customer cash generation: equipment demand does not guarantee funded deployment
supply_chain_view.trend: Inference diversifies memory beyond HBM into DRAM, LPDDR and SSD KV cache. Short links can remain copper while longer and denser links move toward light cables, pluggables, NPO and CPO. AI demand remains strong, but qualified capacity and financial returns determine supplier earnings.
